notes: 'for that within the veil': the that is added, since neither the preposition nor the fused within licenses it (rules 30, 51).
'I give you the priesthood' realizes the 2mp suffix of kehunnatkhem as the indirect object you, and the noun takes the supplied the (rules 15, 18).
kol + devar fuses as 'everything' because a single English word carries both morphemes; where no devar is written (as at v.14, v.15) the same English word is kol plus a supplied generic.
